raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 27 duplicate txn_ids are amount corrections: each is a record_version 2 row that repeats a record_version 1 txn_id, and the payments-source note says the higher version supersedes the original. The silver step keeps both versions, so the duplicates flow into every gold table; deduplicating to the highest record_version per txn_id before the POSTED filter fixes this.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
